desc:
🔍 The Brainrot Skifidol Cards have scattered across the map. Can you collect them all?

✨ Explore 3 different zones and unlock a secret extra area to find all 150 Brainrot Cards and complete the index.

💎 Each card belongs to one of 6 rarities — some are easy to grab, others will make you question your life choices.

🐾 Complete challenges, explore with friends, and hunt down every Skifidol Italian Brainrot card
Completionists welcome. Quitters not.
